tools.name: search_migration_agencies
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to find or compare registered migration agencies in Australia by city, suburb, state, agency name, agent name or MARN. Returns 10 agencies per page with Google rating, review count, number of registered agents, phone, website and a profile URL. Default order is the websit

tools.name: get_migration_agency
tools.description: Use this to read one agency’s public profile after a search, using its returned id. Returns the address, phone, website, every registered agent with their MARN, Google rating, up to 8 reviews (the same selection the profile page shows first), and any languages, specialisations, office hours or descr

tools.name: find_registered_agent
tools.description: Use this to check whether a person appears as a currently registered migration agent, by name or MARN (Migration Agents Registration Number), and to find the agency they work at. Returns up to 8 matches with MARN and agency profile URL. This is our copy of the OMARA register, not a live check; alway

tools.name: list_agency_locations
tools.description: Use this when a location search finds nothing or the place is ambiguous. Lists Australian cities with their number of listed agencies, or with city set, the suburbs of that city. Names returned here work as the location in search_migration_agencies.
